propositions: A standing per-criterion effectiveness recorder is needed to monitor advisory criteria for promotion/demotion without outcome-corpus git-walks or per-criterion wiring, providing zero-LLM-cost detection and FP signals from sidecar re-review history alone.

The recorder appends lean firing rows (ticket, review_ts, round_uuid, norm_id, criteria, verdict, decision) to an append-only prune-immune ledger, auto-including every criterion id observed, idempotent by dedup key (ticket, review_ts, round_uuid, norm_id).

The --report computes per-criterion detection_proxy (fraction of blocking fix-units remediated to PASS in a later round) and blocking_fp_proxy (fraction de-escalated via dropped decision and never remediated) over a trailing window of tickets, providing complementary within-review FP metrics distinct from R7's post-hoc outcome-corpus proxy.

The harness reads only persisted REVIEW_RESULT sidecars and filename envelopes (ts_ns, round_uuid), requires no production-path changes, and produces committed deterministic metrics over existing corpus as CI-visible proof of nontriviality.
